title: Modern GEODATA DXF coordinate-type domain
scope: For GEODATA object versions 2 and 3, the DXF writer accepts coordinate type values 0 through 3 and refuses values outside that documented enumeration before output mutation. Version 1 group 70 remains its distinct legacy control-flags field. Parsing remains tolerant.

normativeSource.title: Autodesk GEODATA (DXF)
normativeSource.group70: Type of design coordinates: 0 unknown, 1 local grid, 2 projected grid, 3 geographic

implementation.behavior: dxfRW::writeGeoData checks m_coordinatesType in the modern v2/v3 path before output or caller-state mutation. The legacy v1 group-70 control flag profile is unchanged.

regressionControl.coverage: For v2 and v3 in ASCII and Binary, values -1 and 4 preserve an output prefix and caller identity, then corrected same-writer output reads back with the corrected value. Generated ASCII/Binary input with v2 group 70 value 4 remains parseable and retains that value.
regressionControl.fixturePolicy: All controls are authored locally in memory; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

nonClaims: No physical producer or native geospatial consumer was qualified.
This does not qualify GEODATA ownership, whole-document graph closure, map projection behavior or DWG encoding semantics.
